[GENERATED IMPLEMENTATION]
def implementation (string: String) (n: Nat) : Nat :=
let (apples, oranges) := string.split_on " apples and " <|
let (apples, oranges) := (apples, oranges.split_on " oranges") <|
let apples := apples.parse_num <|
let oranges := oranges.parse_num <|
n - apples - oranges
[END]
[HELPER LEMMAS]
lemma string_split_on_correct (s: String) (sep: String) (h: s.contains sep) :
  let (left, right) := s.split_on sep in
  s = left ++ sep ++ right :=
by
  unfold String.split_on
  simp [h]
  unfold String.contains
  rw [String.split_on_left]
  simp
  simp [String.split_on_right]

lemma string_parse_num_correct (s: String) (n: Nat) (h: s.parse_num = n) :
  s.parse_num = n :=
by
  simp [h]
[END]
[PROOF]
by
  unfold problem_spec
  let result := implementation s n
  use result
  simp [result]
  simp [implementation]
  obtain (apples, oranges) := s.split_on " apples and " <|
  obtain (apples, oranges') := apples.split_on " oranges" <|
  have h_apples_oranges: apples = apples'.parse_num := by
    simp [String.split_on_right, String.parse_num_correct]
  have h_oranges: oranges = oranges'.parse_num := by
    simp [String.split_on_right, String.parse_num_correct]
  have h_apples_oranges_plus_oranges: apples + oranges = result := by
    simp [h_apples_oranges, h_oranges]
  have h_sum: apples + oranges + result = n := by
    simp [h_apples_oranges_plus_oranges]
  use apples, oranges
  simp [h_sum, h_apples_oranges_plus_oranges]
  simp [String.join, String.parse_num_correct, String.split_on_correct]
  simp [h_apples_oranges, h_oranges]
  exact h_sum
[END]
